name: Roblox: Zorzax
summary: Zorzax is the intergalactic equivalent of a travel blogger, zipping through wormholes to all the hottest spots in space, time, and dimensions untold. But when a quick flyover of New Mexico turned into a long weekend at Area 51—actually, quite a lot of long weekends—they fell in love with this silly little planet...even if the feeling isn't always mutual. Get Zorzax when you sign up for Roblox on PlayStation Plus.
